card.name: The word matter in physics, esp. antimatter
card.fires_on: The word 'matter' (usually the 'atter' ending of 'antimatter') in physics text about antimatter, the early universe, or light-matter interaction.

modes.label: End of antimatter
modes.description: The 'atter' piece completing 'antimatter' or 'anti-matter' in physics discussion.
modes.example: The currently accepted laws of physics say that the Big Bang created as much antim<<atter>> as ordinary matter.

modes.label: Matter as physics term
modes.description: The standalone word 'Matter' or ' matter' in a physics phrase such as light-matter interaction or matter dominating the universe.
